head.label: How We Work
head.title: Understand the problem. Then fix it.
head.lead: We begin by understanding the business. Then we agree what needs to change, who will do the work, and how progress will be measured.
head.img: Image: reviewing a process with the people who run it.

stages.name: Understand
stages.short: We find the cause behind the symptom.
stages.what: We talk to you and your team, look at how the work gets done, and review the numbers. We look for the cause behind the symptom.
stages.out: a clear statement of the problem and what it costs the business.

stages.name: Architect
stages.short: We agree the plan, the people, and the cost.
stages.what: We agree what needs to change, who will do it, what it will cost, and how we will measure it.
stages.out: a plan with roles, costs, and measures.

stages.name: Execute
stages.short: We do the work with your team.
stages.what: We do the work alongside your team and report progress to the person who makes decisions.
stages.out: the agreed work, done and measured.

stages.name: Institutionalise
stages.short: We write it down and hand it over.
stages.what: We write down the new way of working, train the people who will run it, and hand it over.
stages.out: written processes, trained staff, and measures you can keep using.

domains.name: Strategy
domains.lead: Decide which problems to solve first, and why.
domains.jobs: We review how the business makes money and where it loses it, set clear priorities for the next 12 months, and turn the plan into a schedule of work with named owners.

domains.name: Technology
domains.lead: Make your systems fit the way the business works.
domains.jobs: We build or fix websites, set up CRMs so every enquiry is recorded, and automate repeated admin tasks.

domains.name: Marketing
domains.lead: Bring in the right customers, and keep track of them.
domains.jobs: We clarify who you sell to and what you say, plan and run advertising, and check what happens to each enquiry after it arrives.

domains.name: Operations
domains.lead: Make everyday work run smoothly.
domains.jobs: We map how work moves through the business, remove the steps that slow it down, and set up simple reports on how it is going.

domains.name: Talent
domains.lead: Put the right people in the right roles.
domains.jobs: We write clear roles and responsibilities, help recruit for key positions, and train staff on new processes and tools.

domains.name: Data
domains.lead: Base decisions on records you can trust.
domains.jobs: We choose the figures worth tracking, build simple monthly dashboards, and measure whether a change worked.

domains.name: Specialist Partners
domains.lead: Bring in qualified experts when the work needs them.
domains.jobs: Accountants, financial advisers, lawyers, HR professionals, software engineers, and recruiters, managed by HUMMIN under one agreement.

engs.name: Review
engs.body: We investigate a problem and give you a clear plan to fix it.
engs.itemsText: You get a review of the area that is not working, our findings in order of priority, and a practical plan with costs and measures.
engs.comm: a fixed fee for an agreed scope.

engs.name: Project
engs.body: We design and deliver a defined piece of work.
engs.itemsText: You get agreed deliverables and milestones, a clear definition of done, any specialist partners managed by us, and regular progress reports.
engs.comm: paid at milestones. Any extra costs are agreed in advance.

engs.name: Residency
engs.body: A HUMMIN professional works inside your team, with support from Applied Expertise.
engs.itemsText: They coordinate the agreed work day to day, bring in HUMMIN specialists when needed, and are managed by HUMMIN. Their role and reporting lines are set in the contract.
engs.comm: a monthly fee based on scope and the people involved.

values.b: We investigate before prescribing.
values.not: Recommend a fix before we understand the problem.

values.b: We connect insight to implementation.
values.not: Hand over a report and walk away when the work is ours to do.

values.b: We work closely with clients without surrendering professional judgement.
values.not: Tell you what you want to hear.

values.b: We tailor solutions without compromising quality or accountability.
values.not: Sell every client the same solution.

values.b: We treat trust as an obligation and agreed outcomes as a shared priority.
values.not: Share your information without your permission.

values.b: We build systems and people that become stronger through our involvement.
values.not: Make the business depend on us.

val.not: Recommend a fix before we understand the problem.

needs.k: One person who can approve changes.
To the information and systems the work depends on.
With the people who do the work every day.
Agreed at the start, so we both know what a good result looks like.

head.label: Engagements
head.title: Review. Project. Residency.
head.lead: Three ways to work with us. Each one stands alone, and many clients start with a Review.
head.img: Image: a HUMMIN professional on site.

stages.name: Understand
stages.short: We find the cause behind the symptom.
stages.what: We talk to you and your team, look at how the work gets done, and review the numbers. We look for the cause behind the symptom.
stages.out: a clear statement of the problem and what it costs the business.

stages.name: Architect
stages.short: We agree the plan, the people, and the cost.
stages.what: We agree what needs to change, who will do it, what it will cost, and how we will measure it.
stages.out: a plan with roles, costs, and measures.

stages.name: Execute
stages.short: We do the work with your team.
stages.what: We do the work alongside your team and report progress to the person who makes decisions.
stages.out: the agreed work, done and measured.

stages.name: Institutionalise
stages.short: We write it down and hand it over.
stages.what: We write down the new way of working, train the people who will run it, and hand it over.
stages.out: written processes, trained staff, and measures you can keep using.

domains.name: Strategy
domains.lead: Decide which problems to solve first, and why.
domains.jobs: We review how the business makes money and where it loses it, set clear priorities for the next 12 months, and turn the plan into a schedule of work with named owners.

domains.name: Technology
domains.lead: Make your systems fit the way the business works.
domains.jobs: We build or fix websites, set up CRMs so every enquiry is recorded, and automate repeated admin tasks.

domains.name: Marketing
domains.lead: Bring in the right customers, and keep track of them.
domains.jobs: We clarify who you sell to and what you say, plan and run advertising, and check what happens to each enquiry after it arrives.

domains.name: Operations
domains.lead: Make everyday work run smoothly.
domains.jobs: We map how work moves through the business, remove the steps that slow it down, and set up simple reports on how it is going.

domains.name: Talent
domains.lead: Put the right people in the right roles.
domains.jobs: We write clear roles and responsibilities, help recruit for key positions, and train staff on new processes and tools.

domains.name: Data
domains.lead: Base decisions on records you can trust.
domains.jobs: We choose the figures worth tracking, build simple monthly dashboards, and measure whether a change worked.

domains.name: Specialist Partners
domains.lead: Bring in qualified experts when the work needs them.
domains.jobs: Accountants, financial advisers, lawyers, HR professionals, software engineers, and recruiters, managed by HUMMIN under one agreement.

stages.name: Understand
stages.short: We find the cause behind the symptom.
stages.what: We talk to you and your team, look at how the work gets done, and review the numbers. We look for the cause behind the symptom.
stages.out: a clear statement of the problem and what it costs the business.

stages.name: Architect
stages.short: We agree the plan, the people, and the cost.
stages.what: We agree what needs to change, who will do it, what it will cost, and how we will measure it.

stages.name: Execute
stages.short: We do the work with your team.
stages.what: We do the work alongside your team and report progress to the person who makes decisions.
stages.out: the agreed work, done and measured.

stages.name: Institutionalise
stages.short: We write it down and hand it over.
stages.what: We write down the new way of working, train the people who will run it, and hand it over.

domains.name: Strategy
domains.lead: Decide which problems to solve first, and why.
domains.jobs: We review how the business makes money and where it loses it, set clear priorities for the next 12 months, and turn the plan into a schedule of work with named owners.

domains.name: Technology
domains.lead: Make your systems fit the way the business works.
domains.jobs: We build or fix websites, set up CRMs so every enquiry is recorded, and automate repeated admin tasks.

domains.name: Marketing
domains.lead: Bring in the right customers, and keep track of them.
domains.jobs: We clarify who you sell to and what you say, plan and run advertising, and check what happens to each enquiry after it arrives.

domains.name: Operations
domains.lead: Make everyday work run smoothly.
domains.jobs: We map how work moves through the business, remove the steps that slow it down, and set up simple reports on how it is going.

domains.name: Talent
domains.lead: Put the right people in the right roles.
domains.jobs: We write clear roles and responsibilities, help recruit for key positions, and train staff on new processes and tools.

domains.name: Data
domains.lead: Base decisions on records you can trust.
domains.jobs: We choose the figures worth tracking, build simple monthly dashboards, and measure whether a change worked.

domains.name: Specialist Partners
domains.lead: Bring in qualified experts when the work needs them.
domains.jobs: Accountants, financial advisers, lawyers, HR professionals, software engineers, and recruiters, managed by HUMMIN under one agreement.

head.label: Applied Expertise
head.title: The skills we bring to the work.
head.lead: Most business problems touch more than one area. We bring in the skills each problem needs and manage them as one team, so you deal with one point of contact.
head.img: Image: a working session with specialists.

stages.name: Understand
stages.short: We find the cause behind the symptom.
stages.what: We talk to you and your team, look at how the work gets done, and review the numbers. We look for the cause behind the symptom.
stages.out: a clear statement of the problem and what it costs the business.

stages.name: Architect
stages.short: We agree the plan, the people, and the cost.
stages.what: We agree what needs to change, who will do it, what it will cost, and how we will measure it.
stages.out: a plan with roles, costs, and measures.

stages.name: Execute
stages.short: We do the work with your team.
stages.what: We do the work alongside your team and report progress to the person who makes decisions.
stages.out: the agreed work, done and measured.

stages.name: Institutionalise
stages.short: We write it down and hand it over.
stages.what: We write down the new way of working, train the people who will run it, and hand it over.
stages.out: written processes, trained staff, and measures you can keep using.

domains.name: Strategy
domains.lead: Decide which problems to solve first, and why.
domains.jobs: We review how the business makes money and where it loses it, set clear priorities for the next 12 months, and turn the plan into a schedule of work with named owners.

domains.name: Technology
domains.lead: Make your systems fit the way the business works.
domains.jobs: We build or fix websites, set up CRMs so every enquiry is recorded, and automate repeated admin tasks.

domains.name: Marketing
domains.lead: Bring in the right customers, and keep track of them.
domains.jobs: We clarify who you sell to and what you say, plan and run advertising, and check what happens to each enquiry after it arrives.

domains.name: Operations
domains.lead: Make everyday work run smoothly.
domains.jobs: We map how work moves through the business, remove the steps that slow it down, and set up simple reports on how it is going.

domains.name: Talent
domains.lead: Put the right people in the right roles.
domains.jobs: We write clear roles and responsibilities, help recruit for key positions, and train staff on new processes and tools.

domains.name: Data
domains.lead: Base decisions on records you can trust.
domains.jobs: We choose the figures worth tracking, build simple monthly dashboards, and measure whether a change worked.

domains.name: Specialist Partners
domains.lead: Bring in qualified experts when the work needs them.
domains.jobs: Accountants, financial advisers, lawyers, HR professionals, software engineers, and recruiters, managed by HUMMIN under one agreement.

head.lead: Most business problems touch more than one area. We bring in the skills each problem needs and manage them as one team, so you deal with one point of contact.
head.img: Image: a working session with specialists.

stages.name: Understand
stages.short: We find the cause behind the symptom.
stages.what: We talk to you and your team, look at how the work gets done, and review the numbers. We look for the cause behind the symptom.
stages.out: a clear statement of the problem and what it costs the business.

stages.name: Architect
stages.short: We agree the plan, the people, and the cost.
stages.what: We agree what needs to change, who will do it, what it will cost, and how we will measure it.
stages.out: a plan with roles, costs, and measures.

stages.name: Execute
stages.short: We do the work with your team.
stages.what: We do the work alongside your team and report progress to the person who makes decisions.
stages.out: the agreed work, done and measured.

stages.name: Institutionalise
stages.short: We write it down and hand it over.
stages.what: We write down the new way of working, train the people who will run it, and hand it over.
stages.out: written processes, trained staff, and measures you can keep using.

domains.name: Strategy
domains.lead: Decide which problems to solve first, and why.
domains.jobs: We review how the business makes money and where it loses it, set clear priorities for the next 12 months, and turn the plan into a schedule of work with named owners.

domains.name: Technology
domains.lead: Make your systems fit the way the business works.
domains.jobs: We build or fix websites, set up CRMs so every enquiry is recorded, and automate repeated admin tasks.

domains.name: Marketing
domains.lead: Bring in the right customers, and keep track of them.
domains.jobs: We clarify who you sell to and what you say, plan and run advertising, and check what happens to each enquiry after it arrives.

domains.name: Operations
domains.lead: Make everyday work run smoothly.
domains.jobs: We map how work moves through the business, remove the steps that slow it down, and set up simple reports on how it is going.

domains.name: Talent
domains.lead: Put the right people in the right roles.
domains.jobs: We write clear roles and responsibilities, help recruit for key positions, and train staff on new processes and tools.

domains.name: Data
domains.lead: Base decisions on records you can trust.
domains.jobs: We choose the figures worth tracking, build simple monthly dashboards, and measure whether a change worked.

domains.name: Specialist Partners
domains.lead: Bring in qualified experts when the work needs them.
domains.jobs: Accountants, financial advisers, lawyers, HR professionals, software engineers, and recruiters, managed by HUMMIN under one agreement.

engs.name: Review
engs.body: We investigate a problem and give you a clear plan to fix it.
engs.itemsText: You get a review of the area that is not working, our findings in order of priority, and a practical plan with costs and measures.
engs.comm: a fixed fee for an agreed scope.

engs.name: Project
engs.body: We design and deliver a defined piece of work.
engs.itemsText: You get agreed deliverables and milestones, a clear definition of done, any specialist partners managed by us, and regular progress reports.
engs.comm: paid at milestones. Any extra costs are agreed in advance.

engs.name: Residency
engs.body: A HUMMIN professional works inside your team, with support from Applied Expertise.
engs.itemsText: They coordinate the agreed work day to day, bring in HUMMIN specialists when needed, and are managed by HUMMIN. Their role and reporting lines are set in the contract.
engs.comm: a monthly fee based on scope and the people involved.

values.b: We investigate before prescribing.
values.not: Recommend a fix before we understand the problem.

values.b: We connect insight to implementation.
values.not: Hand over a report and walk away when the work is ours to do.

values.b: We work closely with clients without surrendering professional judgement.
values.not: Tell you what you want to hear.

values.b: We tailor solutions without compromising quality or accountability.
values.not: Sell every client the same solution.

values.b: We treat trust as an obligation and agreed outcomes as a shared priority.

values.b: We build systems and people that become stronger through our involvement.
values.not: Make the business depend on us.

val.not: Recommend a fix before we understand the problem.

head.label: How We Work
head.title: Understand the problem. Then fix it.
head.lead: We begin by understanding the business. Then we agree what needs to change, who will do the work, and how progress will be measured.
head.img: Image: reviewing a process with the people who run it.

stages.name: Understand
stages.short: We find the cause behind the symptom.
stages.what: We talk to you and your team, look at how the work gets done, and review the numbers. We look for the cause behind the symptom.
stages.out: a clear statement of the problem and what it costs the business.

stages.name: Architect
stages.short: We agree the plan, the people, and the cost.
stages.what: We agree what needs to change, who will do it, what it will cost, and how we will measure it.
stages.out: a plan with roles, costs, and measures.

stages.name: Execute
stages.short: We do the work with your team.
stages.what: We do the work alongside your team and report progress to the person who makes decisions.
stages.out: the agreed work, done and measured.

stages.name: Institutionalise
stages.short: We write it down and hand it over.
stages.what: We write down the new way of working, train the people who will run it, and hand it over.
stages.out: written processes, trained staff, and measures you can keep using.

domains.name: Strategy
domains.lead: Decide which problems to solve first, and why.
domains.jobs: We review how the business makes money and where it loses it, set clear priorities for the next 12 months, and turn the plan into a schedule of work with named owners.

domains.name: Technology
domains.lead: Make your systems fit the way the business works.
domains.jobs: We build or fix websites, set up CRMs so every enquiry is recorded, and automate repeated admin tasks.

domains.name: Marketing
domains.lead: Bring in the right customers, and keep track of them.
domains.jobs: We clarify who you sell to and what you say, plan and run advertising, and check what happens to each enquiry after it arrives.

domains.name: Operations
domains.lead: Make everyday work run smoothly.
domains.jobs: We map how work moves through the business, remove the steps that slow it down, and set up simple reports on how it is going.

domains.name: Talent
domains.lead: Put the right people in the right roles.
domains.jobs: We write clear roles and responsibilities, help recruit for key positions, and train staff on new processes and tools.

domains.name: Data
domains.lead: Base decisions on records you can trust.
domains.jobs: We choose the figures worth tracking, build simple monthly dashboards, and measure whether a change worked.

domains.name: Specialist Partners
domains.lead: Bring in qualified experts when the work needs them.
domains.jobs: Accountants, financial advisers, lawyers, HR professionals, software engineers, and recruiters, managed by HUMMIN under one agreement.
